name: vacuum_defer_cleanup_age
description: Number of transactions by which VACUUM and HOT cleanup of dead row versions is deferred to allow standby queries more time to complete.
symptoms: standby query cancellation due to missing tuples
replication lag spikes during heavy vacuum activity
tuning_tips: Increase only if standby queries are frequently canceled due to tuple visibility conflicts; monitor replication lag and disk usage, as higher values increase WAL retention and table bloat on the primary.
